v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

text.la: Lauréntius * ingréssus est Martyr, et conféssus est nomen Dómini Iesu Christi.
text.en: Lawrence * went in to be a martyr, and acknowledged the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

text.la: Lauréntius * bonum opus operátus est, qui per signum crucis cæcos illuminávit.
text.en: Lawrence wrought a good work, * in that with the sign of the Cross he gave sight to the blind.

text.la: Adhǽsit * ánima mea post te, quia caro mea igne cremáta est pro te, Deus meus.
text.en: O my God, my soul cleaveth * fast after thee, for my flesh hath been burnt with fire for thy sake.

text.la: Misit Dóminus * Angelum suum, et liberávit me de médio ignis, et non sum æstuátus.
text.en: The Lord hath sent His Angel, * and hath delivered me out of the midst of the fire, so that I am not scorched.

text.la: Beátus Lauréntius * orábat, dicens: Grátias tibi ago, Dómine, quia iánuas tuas íngredi mérui.
text.en: The blessed Lawrence prayed * and said: I give thee thanks, O Lord, that Thou hast made me worthy to enter within thy gates.

text.la: Fratres: Qui parce séminat, parce et metet; et qui séminat in benedictiónibus, de benedictiónibus et metet.
text.en: Brethren: He which soweth sparingly shall reap also sparingly, and he which soweth bountifully shall reap also bountifully.

v.la: Levíta Lauréntius bonum opus operátus est.
v.en: The Levite Lawrence wrought a good work.

r.la: Qui per signum crucis cæcos illuminávit.
r.en: In that with the sign of the Cross he gave sight to the blind.

text.la: Beátus Lauréntius, * dum in cratícula superpósitus urerétur, ad impiíssimum tyránnum dixit: Assátum est iam, versa et mandúca; nam facultátes Ecclésiæ, quas requíris, in cæléstes thesáuros manus páuperum deportavérunt.
text.en: When the blessed Lawrence was lying, stretched upon the bars, and burning, he said * to the iniquitous magistrate: The cooking is done enough now, turn the meat and eat; for the property of the Church, which thou seekest, hath been garnered up in heaven by the hands of the poor.

text.la: Da nobis, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: vitiórum nostrórum flammas exstínguere; qui beáto Lauréntio tribuísti tormentórum suórum incéndia superáre.
text.en: O Almighty God, Who didst give unto Blessed Lawrence power to be more than conqueror in his fiery torment, grant unto us, we beseech thee, the power to quench the flames of our sinful lusts.
